name: City of Oakland
disclaimer: Verify with Oakland Planning & Building Department. Oakland has a proactive ADU program.

notes: Oakland has a robust ADU pre-approved plan library (Oakland Standard Plans).
Hillside areas require Hillside Development Permit and geotechnical review.
Oakland Hills fire history means WUI-area properties require ignition-resistant construction.
Oakland's ADU Pilot Program offers pre-approved designs with fast-track permitting.

fire.note: Oakland Hills (above Hwy 13 and Hwy 24 in parts) experienced the 1991 firestorm. High Fire Severity Zone designation applies to many hillside parcels.
